modifications: Retained the two source Draco payloads, material properties, authored names and coordinates without remeshing; compacted package tables and byte offsets only.

coordinates.sourceToApp: Apply complete FBX node world transform, then divide positions by 100. This model is not spatially registered to BodyParts3D 4.0.

limitations: Only the bilateral named submental artery source surfaces are included; no terminal arterioles or complete mylohyoid perfusion are modeled.
The separately authored mylohyoid branch of the inferior alveolar artery is not included or connected.

subset.modifications: Original compressed triangles, material attributes, source names, identifiers and Z frame retained; only package tables and byte offsets compacted. Reviewed side and region metadata added; ordinary arterial layer visibility remains enabled.
subset.scope: Named right and left submental artery surfaces only; no reconstructed terminal arterioles or complete mylohyoid perfusion.
